name: @quadraui/node
description: napi-rs bindings: insert quadraui descriptors from JavaScript/TypeScript and render them headlessly.

scripts.build:dist: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --outDir dist --rootDir js js/index.ts && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('js/index.d.ts','dist/index.d.ts');require('fs').copyFileSync('js/wire.d.ts','dist/wire.d.ts')"
scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc --strict --noEmit --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --types node examples/*.ts
